entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-07-09
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Revert #67075: hidden-member validation fix is incomplete and regresses behavior #67711
  • Add protected method to notify InputBase<> of changes to CurrentValue #67703
  • Generic version of ConsumesAttribute #67701
  • IJSObjectReference.SetValueAsync #67698
  • `TypedResults.ValidationProblem` should allow different status codes #67696
  • Benchmark stopped running: QueryCompilation #67693
  • Perf regression: multiple_queries #67692

Closed

  • Perf improvement: json, mvc #67691
  • Consider introducing new attribute for Microsoft.AspNetCore.OpenAPI #67704
  • Test flaky: AddValidationIntegrationTest.FormWithNestedValidation_Works #67699
  • Add HttpSys support for accessing TLS channel binding tokens #66701
    .NET 11 Planning
  • Accessibility: QuickGrid Paginator link mode puts aria-label on boundary anchor elements that have no href or role #67615

    11.0-preview7
  • Quarantine QuickGridInteractiveTest.SortByTypeMismatchVirtualizedShowsClearError #67632
  • Update Microsoft.OpenAPi package due to security vulnerability #67694
  • Perf improvement: antiforgery-noop #67684
  • DataAnnotationsValidator throws AmbiguousMatchException when there are hidden members #27095
    Backlog
  • Suggestion: Improve CreateTwoFactorRecoveryCode for .NET 8+ #67668

Created
